component.name: Odyssey Launcher
component.summary: Browse and launch your games in 3D

description.p: Odyssey Launcher is a fully 3D launcher for your emulators and PC games. Every system and every game is a floating 3D model: systems appear as their own consoles, as slabs with their logos or as flat logo cards, and games come in their boxes, cases and cabinets, wrapped in their cover art. Pick a system, pick a game, and it starts in your emulator. When you quit the game, you're back where you left off.

ul.li: Finds your games in ES-DE's ROM folders, and your emulators where they're installed: a distribution's package, a Flatpak or an AppImage
Downloads covers, screenshots, logos, videos and manuals from ScreenScraper, LaunchBox's Games DB, IGDB and SteamGridDB
Plays a game's video and opens its manual
Runs Steam games and your own desktop shortcuts and scripts
Can be driven entirely with a controller, including its settings
Themes to choose from and download, and your own 3D models for systems and games

description.p: Odyssey Launcher includes no games, BIOS files or emulators.
